messages:
sam_sales: Quick sync — Avalon (evan) wants a 3-week POC to validate LLM assistant for claims triage. They flagged HIPAA + EU data residency. Proposed scope: 1) hosted sandbox with isolated tenant, 2) eval set of ~200 prompts, 3) SLA goals (p95 latency <300ms), 4) SOC2 + DPA evidence. Can we confirm what's feasible and blockers?

evan_avalon: thanks Sam. correct — we need BAA for PHI scope, SOC2 Type II report, and EU data residency (Frankfurt region). Also will need pen-test window and list of IPs for allowlist. timeline: target go/no-go in 3 weeks.

luca_csm: noted. we'll own onboarding + eval coordination on our side. EVAN: can you drop the representative prompt set by EOD Monday? even 150-200 prompts is fine.

anya_se: technical quick notes: Hosted sandbox can be isolated under a dedicated org with tenant-level controls and token scoping. For EU residency we can route requests to eu-region model endpoints — data at rest will be in eu region if we enable the region flag. For BAA, we need legal sign-off but we provide a standard BAA template; for HIPAA we also require customer to accept the DPA addendum.

joy_security: security asks from Avalon we need to validate: SOC2 Type II report (last 12 months), DPA + BAA, encryption at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS1.2+), KMS integration for customer-managed keys (optional), pen-test results or window, and logging/retention details. Also confirm limited personnel access and account audit logs.

dylan_eng: engineering constraints: For the p95 <300ms target we need to size the sandbox GPU pool with min 2 concurrent workers and set batching to low-latency mode. We'll simulate with a 200-prompt eval harness. Also: can do prefix caching but that requires knowing prompt patterns. If any prompts contain PHI, we'll mark them and ensure KV cache retention is disabled for those.

sam_sales: Evan — is the 200-prompt eval expected to include PHI? we can redact or use synthetic PHI if needed. what's your preference?

evan_avalon: some prompts will have PHI examples. preferred: synthetic data if possible for public demo, but we must show a small PHI-realistic sample under BAA controls during private test.

anya_se: plan: Week 0 (prep) — sign DPA/BAA, exchange SOC2 report + access to security portal; Week 1 — sandbox provisioning + baseline traffic tests; Week 2 — eval run + latency/cost measurement; Week 3 — results review + decision. Is that acceptable?

luca_csm: will run the eval coordination and collect success criteria from product stakeholders. Proposed success criteria draft: a) p95 latency <300ms for typical prompt lengths (~120 tokens), b) throughput >= 8 RPS sustained, c) quality pass rate >= 92% on the labeled eval set, d) no PHI leakage observed in audits, e) integration smoke test (API + allowlist + KMS).

joy_security: add security pass conditions: 1) signed BAA + DPA; 2) SOC2 Type II report reviewed + any open items addressed; 3) scheduled pen-test window and scope agreed (app + infra, no social engineering); 4) IP allowlist and audit log retention config. Also require data deletion procedures for POC data.

dylan_eng: practical items we need from Avalon: 1) representative prompt file (CSV), 2) target latency SLOs and concurrency profile, 3) allowlist IPs or VPC peering details, 4) whether they want customer-managed keys (KMS) or Redwood-managed.

evan_avalon: will send prompt CSV and allowlist IPs by Mon. we prefer KMS-managed by Avalon. pen-test: target week 3, 48h window. SOC2 links: will need to get you to our procurement team for reciprocal checks?

sam_sales: re pricing: POC pricing model — we can offer a capped usage credit for the 3-week POC plus engineering support hours. Estimate: $X credit covering up to 200k tokens + 8 hours of SE time. If they enable dedicated sandbox GPUs, there will be a small infra pass-through for reserved capacity. I'll send an itemized estimate.

luca_csm: I'll capture success criteria and send final acceptance checklist by Tue AM. Evan, we'll need stakeholder sign-off (PM + security) at the end of Week 3 for go/no-go.

joy_security: one more—pen-test scope doc: please confirm external IPs, auth flows, and whether test can use a staging dataset. We'll require 5 business days notice for scheduling and an IP range to allowlist for the testing origin.

dylan_eng: for the eval harness, sample quick command we'll run:```python
# run eval
results = run_eval('avalon_prompts.csv', model='redwood-xlhf', max_tokens=256)
print(summary(results))```we'll share raw outputs and metrics dashboard.

evan_avalon: thanks all. sounds good. sending prompts + allowlist today. we'll review BAA and SOC2 doc links and circle back.

sam_sales: perfect — next steps: I will prod legal for BAA template, Anya will request region flag for eu sandbox, Dylan will size the sandbox, Joy will share security checklist. Luca will coordinate eval stakeholders. tagging @deploy-bot for provisioning ticket. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Provisioning ticket created: INF-4821 — sandbox eu (dedicated-tenant), owner=dylan_eng, ETA 48h.
